Cognate with Saterland Frisian tiedig (“timely, early”), Dutch tijdig (“timely”), German Low German tiedig (“timely”), German zeitig (“seasonal, timely”), Danish tidig (“timely”), Swedish tidig (“timely”).

wiktionary.gloss: Expression of agreement or positive acknowledgement, usually in reply to a question; great, fine.

idioms.gloss: To do, or supposedly do, a mundane and unimportant activity as an excuse to avoid something onerous or unappealing.
In a state of good order; tidy.

phrasal_verbs.gloss: To make clean, to make satisfactorily neat.

examples: The 9/11 attacks weren't very good for America. / To say the least!
His performance, to say the least, didn't impress me.
wiktionary.gloss: Used to suggest an understatement.

blocks.etymology: From un- + besought.
